text: OVERDOSAGE Amphotericin B desoxycholate overdose has been reported to result in cardio-respiratory arrest. Fifteen patients have been reported to have received one or more doses of ABELCET ® between 7-13 mg/kg. None of these patients had a serious acute reaction to ABELCET ® . If an overdose is suspected, discontinue therapy, monitor the patient's clinical status, and administer supportive therapy as required. ABELCET ® is not hemodialyzable.
